data.body: RUNBOOK NOTE (from coherence review, 2026-06-04, seam G-C): document the FP-recovery -> PR2 resume seam. When the two-tier flow escalates to FP-recovery (an out-of-band human web-UI merge of PR1), merge-to-main.sh does NOT automatically hand back to create PR2 — the FP-recovery workflow ends at 'human merges via web UI'. This session had to manually resolve the staged-base version conflict, merge origin/main into staged, and create PR2 (#632) by hand. The two-tier UX docs should add a runbook step: after an FP-recovery PR1 merge, how to resume to PR2 (and that 0f17's KEEP fix removes the version-conflict step).
